# Code of Conduct

## Our Standard

We want `kubecfg` to be a respectful, practical, and collaborative project.

Participants are expected to:

- be respectful in discussions and reviews
- assume good intent and communicate clearly
- focus feedback on code, behavior, and decisions
- be constructive when reporting bugs or suggesting changes
- help keep the project welcoming for contributors of different backgrounds and experience levels

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following behaviors are not acceptable in project spaces:

- harassment, insults, or personal attacks
- discriminatory or hateful language
- trolling, intimidation, or deliberately hostile behavior
- publishing private information without consent
- repeated off-topic or disruptive conduct

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to:

- GitHub issues
- pull requests
- code review discussions
- project-linked community spaces

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit, remove, or reject comments, issues, pull requests, or contributions that do not follow this code of conduct.

Repeated or severe violations may lead to temporary or permanent restrictions from participating in the project.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact the maintainers through GitHub and include enough context for review.

All reports will be handled as carefully and confidentially as possible.
